notes: 0.18.8 - PR #23 test build (stacked on PRs #17-#22, none merged). The Slices editor's Add buttons become a picker: open Add a slice under Slices and search across three tabs. Actions adds eight Android destinations - Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, display and location settings, battery, data usage, and alarms. Apps is the add-an-app flow from 0.18.7. Shortcuts expands any app to show the shortcuts it publishes and pins one as a slice (needs Kinto as your default Home app). Entries already in the pie are marked and the 12-slice cap is enforced in the picker too. Both pies fire all three kinds. Everything from 0.18.7 rides along, including honest brightness and ringer controls with the Android access links.
